jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Growth
jobs.description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
 
Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
 
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
 
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
 
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
 
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?
 

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.


    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

     

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

 💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus
 
If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.
  • Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.

Requirements

  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.

  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.
